title: Score des expériences adverses de l'enfance (ACE)
formula:
The ACE Score is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| During your first 18 years of life… | | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Variable | Points | |
| Did a parent or other adult in the household often or very often ... Swear at you, insult you, put you down, or humiliate you? or Act in a way that made you afraid that you might be physically hurt? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Did a parent or other adult in the household often or very often ... Push, grab, slap, or throw something at you? or Ever hit you so hard that you had marks or were injured? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Did an adult or person at least five years older than you ever ... Touch or fondle you or have you touch their body in a sexual way? or Attempt or actually have oral, anal, or vaginal intercourse with you? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Did you often or very often feel that... No one in your family loved you or thought you were important or special? or Your family didn’t look out for each other, feel close to each other, or support each other? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Did you often or very often feel that... You didn’t have enough to eat, had to wear dirty clothes, and had no one to protect you? or Your parents were too drunk or high to take care of you or take you to the doctor if you needed it? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Were your parents ever separated or divorced? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Was your mother or stepmother: Often or very often pushed, grabbed, slapped, or had something thrown at her? or Sometimes, often, or very often kicked, bitten, hit with a fist, or hit with something hard? or Ever repeatedly hit at least a few minutes or threatened with a gun or knife? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Did you live with anyone who was a problem drinker or alcoholic or who used street drugs? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Was a household member depressed or mentally ill, or did a household member attempt suicide? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Did a household member go to prison? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |

how_to_use.why:
- Ce score donne un aperçu de l’exposition d’un patient à des événements potentiellement indésirables pendant l’enfance, lesquels sont liés à une augmentation des risques pour la santé physique, mentale et sociale.
- L’identification précoce des ACEs peut aider à la prévention et à l’intervention précoce.
how_to_use.when: - Utilisez cet outil pour dépister et surveiller les expériences négatives de l’enfance (ACEs) chez
how_to_use.pearls:
- Il est crucial de ne pas surinterpréter le score : des scores ACE plus élevés indiquent un risque accru de résultats de santé indésirables, mais ils ne permettent pas de prédire des problèmes spécifiques.
- Les discussions sur les traumatismes peuvent être source de détresse pour certains patients ; abordez ces conversations avec sensibilité et créez un environnement bienveillant et soutenant.

next_steps.advice:
- Utiliser les résultats pour déterminer la nécessité d'un soutien en santé mentale, d'un accompagnement psychologique ou d'une orientation vers des spécialistes des soins tenant compte des traumatismes ou vers des travailleurs sociaux.
- Informer les patients de leurs résultats, en discutant de leur pertinence, des risques pour la santé associés et des ressources disponibles en santé mentale afin d'aider à atténuer les effets à long terme des ACEs.
next_steps.critical_actions: Lors de l’évaluation d’un mineur, s’il existe une inquiétude immédiate de maltraitance ou de négligence, contactez les services de protection de l’enfance (CPS) afin d’assurer la sécurité et le bien-être de l’enfant. Le signalement est une obligation légale et éthique dans la plupart des juridictions.

more_info: Un score ACE plus élevé correspond à un risque plus élevé de problèmes de santé, sociaux et émotionnels.
medium_description: Dépistage des expériences négatives de l'enfance.
